_about: The Signals inspectors' hand scanner on the ore train (docs/maps/ore_train.md, 'Scanner sweep'). The cone is the only way an inspector notices Red: length_m long, half_angle_deg each side of where the scanner points, which swings sweep_deg left and right once every sweep_period_s. Red has to stay inside it, unblocked, for spot_time_s to be spotted (the cone turns red and a question mark pops up: never an exclamation mark, that is the battle cue). Anything in the group 'cover' taller than cover_min_height (ore heaps, container stacks, freight stacks) blocks the ray from the scanner (scan_height up) to Red's chest (target_height up); the low lashed crates do not. A cutscene pauses the sweep and the detection. After he spots her he is a normal map enemy (chase, then a fight if he catches her).
